focus_areas: Integrity of the white facial blaze (checking for melting or irregular edges)
Geometry and attachment of the halter straps
Leg-Hoof connection integrity through the blur
Distinction between photographic blur and AI smearing
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the white blaze on the face and the halter. Use the open_vocabulary_detector results to ensure these features are distinct objects and not texturing errors or melted regions. Verify that the halter straps have logical geometry and do not fuse into the horse's skin or mane. Additionally, examine the lower legs: determine if the blur hides structural anomalies (like missing hooves or fused toes) or if it is consistent with depth-of-field/motion blur from a camera.

The coat is uniform chestnut/sorrel color with no black points. The background consists of green grass and blurred trees.
